body.p: Please replace paragraph [0003] on page 1 with the following amended paragraph: It is known from EP 2134602 2336824 to mount the seat pan to pivot about a front pivot axis. The seat pan is inclined upwardly when in a seating configuration. The rear of the seat pan is raised to re-configure the seat to a berthing configuration.
Please insert the following heading immediately following paragraph [0004] on page 1: SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
Please replace paragraph [0004] on page 1 with the following amended paragraph: Aspects of the present invention relate to an aircraft seat; and to an aircraft as claimed in the appended claims.
